channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Monday Club Night: Big Matches at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium with two big mixed matches (Grade 4 and Grade 7), Juvenile Club sessions, and two courts open from 9pm for members.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 5 Matches Played, 13 More to Come
item.description: A busy week of league and cup action: two league draws, a big cup win for Grade 7 Mixed, and a tough away loss for Grade 2 Men’s. Next week ramps up with 13 matches across league and cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont: Navan 'B' v WSBC (Grade 4 Mixed)

item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont: Navan ‘A’ vs Bailieboro (Grade 4 Mixed)
item.description: Another Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium with a Grade 4 Mixed league matchup (Navan ‘A’ vs Bailieboro), plus two member courts available from 8pm and juvenile league matches.

item.title: 12 Matches Completed: Big League Wins & Cup Drama

item.title: Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims – Best of Luck to Our Meath Representatives

item.title: Thursday Club Night — Last One of January!

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Navan 'A' vs Trim 'A' + Members’ Courts from 8pm

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Matches, Members Courts & Juveniles
